name: failedBackupJobsCount
definition: The number of devices listed as failed across the backup plans the tool reads (the sum of each plan's backup_failed_on list). An error, refusal, empty read, or any plan without a backup_failed_on list is Not evaluated, never 0.
population: the backup plans the credential's company returns; numerator = device entries in backup_failed_on across every plan read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A read of the backup plans in which every plan carries a backup_failed_on list; 0 only when every list is present and empty. An error, refusal, empty or partial read is Not evaluated.

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real IDrive body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: A plan whose backup_failed_on is missing, null or a string is not read as zero failures; the whole count is then null with a dataCollection error, so a "0 failed" requirement cannot pass on missing data. Device entries are counted per plan, so a device failing under two plans counts twice.
